abi.name: MSVC-v141-Win32-static-CRT
abi.runtime: Static MSVC CRT/STL, Concurrency Runtime and UCRT; no CRT sidecars

limitations: Experimental shared model/protocol/policy/recovery/diagnostic projection build, not a supported historical product.
Tests run on Windows 10 x64 through WOW64 unless a separate exact guest record says otherwise. XP/7 execution and desktop qualification remain unproven.
Native IPC, supervision, protected policy and UI adapters remain disabled until their historical contracts/imports are closed.
Intended XP SP3 x86 SSE2 floor is a hypothesis. PE imports and toolset selection are necessary but insufficient runtime proof.
Key installed tool/runtime/header files are pinned; complete archive/header closure and bit-for-bit reproduction remain unproven.
Bounded recent-failure codec is shared; native private-file recording/reading runs only on modern Windows/Linux profiles and has no product retention or power-loss guarantee.
The preservation policy predicate is portable and tested on the host; native copy/UI components remain excluded from this historical profile.
Synchronized data view/model reconciliation is tested as a typed in-process consumer; no telemetry wire feature, real collector, renderer or native data-erasure qualification is enabled.
Telemetry document codec preserves complete wire state and exact body replay bytes; codec validation alone does not publish model state or authorize a subscription.
Complete remote state import is an in-process policy-bound receive component; native subscription/demand and producer-monotonic freshness mapping remain unqualified.
Bounded subscription sessions are tested portably; the modern native probe exchanges synthetic inventory only, with no measured-field freshness, real collector or product capability qualification.

Measured telemetry 0.2 has explicit native clock scope and portable freshness/replay tests; native synthetic delivery is enabled only in modern profiles, without real collector, suspend or namespace-migration qualification.

Shared network lifetimes, demand cancellation and integer counter intervals are implemented; Linux watched acquisition has native registration/read evidence, while real topology fault induction, Windows notification coverage and supervised measured publication remain open.

Measured network projection is shared; Linux runs the finite real collector/supervision composition. Product service wiring, installed policy distribution, full network inventory, actual kernel faults and other native platform publication remain unqualified.

Shared measured network presentation preserves exact selected lifetime, status axes, deterministic rate text and current-policy borrowing. Native renderer delivery/cache erasure and visible operational telemetry remain unqualified.
Pinned content and preset composition produce policy-checked previews; external resource persistence, media decoding and activation remain open. Native private-directory reading is Linux-only.
Command 0.3 binds selected content to immutable resource snapshots. Resource-bearing Linux generations recover exact bytes; installed ownership, media decoding and actual activation remain open.

The common resource provider retains the exact current closure for further edits. Linux additionally composes command 0.3 with native supervision and private catalog discovery; installed policy/store ownership, media decoding and activation remain open.

Shared scene layout resolves every admitted layout kind using explicit topology and readable metrics. Exact geometry/pixel-bound tests do not qualify native fonts, raster rendering, direct editing, host placement or activation.

Authored selectors and pins now project scoped policy-bound DataViews with bounded exact ordering and explicit incomplete outcomes. Native routing/mapping ownership, text measurement, drawing and retained-cache erasure remain integration requirements.

Shared scene 0.3 content and command 0.4 validate explicit text/labels/chart settings/image pins. Native text and label rendering/recovery evidence is Linux-only; chart/image drawing and complete editions remain unqualified.
